title: Listen and Choose a Response — Everyday Life

questions.stem: Can you recommend a good dentist around here?

options.A: I brush my teeth twice a day.
options.B: Yes, I recommended it to him.
options.C: I go to Dr. Patel on Main Street, and she's great.
options.D: It's around here somewhere, I think.

questions.explanation: A recommendation request is answered with a specific dentist. The others give unrelated habits, a pronoun mismatch, or repeat 'around here'.
questions.speaker: f3
